source_summary: A pale ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with layered snowy or mist-softened mountains, rivers, pavilions, a pagoda, clustered trees, bridge figures, and a small boat. Calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: central_pagoda_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the slender multi-tier pagoda rising from a wooded islet on the left-center lake shore, including the small clustered trees and rocky base immediately around it.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry and finial
fine vertical linework of the tower
dark ink outlines on each eave
speckled tree foliage around the base
pale wash transition into surrounding water and shore

motifs.name: left_lakeside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small lakeside building cluster tucked among trees and rocks at lower left-center, with several tiled roofs and warm reddish-brown architectural accents.
must_preserve: layered roof ridges and upturned eaves
thin structural lines for walls and posts
muted red-orange color accents on roofs and walls
dense stippled foliage enclosing the buildings
rounded pale rock forms framing the settlement

motifs.name: right_monumental_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side mountain and cliff mass with rounded pale snow-like surfaces, dark fissures, tree-dotted ridges, and steep vertical rock faces.
must_preserve: curving contour lines on rounded rock faces
vertical crag fissures and dark dry-brush texture
dense stippled trees along ridgelines
soft pale wash on broad mountain planes
mist-softened edges where cliffs recede

motifs.name: right_hillside_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and house group embedded in the right mountainside, including the upper tiny pavilion, lower roofed halls, surrounding rocks, and enclosing trees.
must_preserve: small roof triangles and tiled eaves
delicate wall and railing linework
subtle red-orange building accents
tree stippling packed around the structures
rock ledges supporting the architecture

motifs.name: central_vertical_rock_spires
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central-left vertical rock spires and adjoining wooded ravine, with pale cliff faces, long dark seams, and shrubs at the base and crest.
must_preserve: elongated vertical contour strokes
dark crevice lines running down the cliffs
rounded pale rock caps
fine clustered foliage at cliff edges
small scattered boulders at the foot of the rocks

motifs.name: foreground_bridge_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the lower middle-right arched footbridge crossing the water, the tiny scholar figures on and near it, the small open pavilion to the right, and the immediate riverbank stones.
must_preserve: thin bridge rails and angled supports
tiny human figures with dark ink outlines and small color accents
open pavilion roof and posts
scattered rounded stones in the shallow water
soft grey water wash around the crossing

motifs.name: lower_garden_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower center-left garden pavilion set amid bamboo-like grasses, shrubs, rounded rocks, and a fenced or banked garden edge.
must_preserve: simple pavilion roof plane and vertical posts
fine fence or bank linework beside the structure
dense bamboo and grass strokes
rounded garden rocks and shrubs
pale wash separating paths, water, and vegetation

motifs.name: lower_boat_willow_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat near the lower right water, together with the adjacent rocky bank, overhanging willow-like tree, grasses, and nearby rounded shoreline rocks.
must_preserve: slender boat hull and pointed ends
tiny seated figure or cargo marks inside the boat
drooping willow and shrub brushwork
rocky promontory with dark stippled texture
soft water wash surrounding the boat

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
